title: ValveEventPayload
description: Event and state payload for water leak sensors and motorized water valves.

leak_detected.description: True if water leak sensor is currently triggered

valve_state.description: Current mechanical state of the motorized water shutoff valve

sensor_id.description: Identifier of the specific leak sensor that triggered the event

auto_closed.description: True if valve was closed autonomously by local HAOS automation

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event
